messages.subject: Microclimate in future climates?
parts:
Hi all,

This is probably a stupid question: is there a microclimate model for future climates? If so, can someone please kindly point me in the right direction for implementing it?
Thanks if so,
Jenn

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Microclimate in future climates?
parts:
Hi Jenn,

It's a matter of adding the appropriate temperature, rainfall, etc. offsets to the base climatology you're using, in the function you're using to run the microclimate model, so it runs off those adjusted forcing variables. I haven't yet collated one to go with the New et al. 2002 climate data. I have for Australia and New Zealand. You can't run the micro_aust or micro_nz functions without access to the requisite data sets but you can look at the code in those functions for generating the climate change scenarios and emulate that with a global climate change scenario.

All the best,
Mike
